title: A Radiators for the Weather
author: Odile Thornbury
blurb: Wendell Galloway, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it before the demolition date arrives.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
